question:
The given bar graph represents the sales of automobiles (in Rs. crores) by five companies A. B, C, D and E in the years 2007-2008 and 2008-2009.

Study the bar graph and answer the question that follows.

*(Note: The data shown below is only for mathematical exercise. It does not represent the actual figures of the companies)*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9116675258f188b4526ae6aff2531231bb417aaa166128de05ba1f8a8d0cc5c6.png] 

What is the percentage difference (correct to two places of decimals) of the combined sales of the five companies in 2008-2009 compared to the combined sales of the five companies in 2007-2008?
solution:
Calculation:

The combined sales of the five companies in 2007-2008 = 1650 + 1350 + 1000 + 1760 + 1440 = 7200 Cr.

The combined sales of the five companies in 2008-2009 = 1250 + 1100 + 1080 + 1600 + 1050 = 6080 Cr.

Hence, % difference = {(7200 - 6080) over 7200} times 100\% approx 15.56\%

**∴ 15.56% is the percentage difference of the combined sales of the five companies in 2008-2009 compared to the combined sales of the five companies in 2007-2008.**
